num_customers: <int> Total number of customers to be served.
num_vehicles: <int> Maximum number of vehicles available in the fleet.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand that a single vehicle can carry on its route.
num_edge_sets: <int> Number of edge sets in the road network partition.
schedule_horizon: <int> End of the scheduling window within which all vehicles must return to the depot.

nodes.id: <int> Unique identifier for this node, where 0 is the depot and 1 through num_customers are customers.
nodes.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of this node's location.
nodes.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of this node's location.
nodes.demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be delivered to this node (0 for the depot).
nodes.time_window_start: <int> Earliest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.time_window_end: <int> Latest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.service_time: <int> Time a vehicle must spend at this node before departing.

edge_sets.id: <int> Unique identifier for this edge set.
edge_sets.access_cost: <float> Fixed cost the company must pay to use any edge in this set.
edge_sets.edges: <list[list[int]], length varies> Pairs of node identifiers representing undirected edges belonging to this set.

free_edges: <list[list[int]], length varies> Pairs of node identifiers representing undirected edges that can be traversed without paying any access cost.
distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Euclidean distance between each pair of nodes, used as both traversal cost and travel time.
